dialogues.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
dialogues.text: It's not fair! How come we only get one shot at this!?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I'm talking about the competition! Why is it that I'm not allowed to continue after losing just one match!?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I can still fight! Everyone's waiting to play with the Fungi that I should be bringing home!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You have to make it through the preliminary round to be able to continue... Didn't you know that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It feels like you signed up out of passion and didn't read the rules at all...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's very unfortunate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever the case, you already did your best and there's no point in looking back. It'd be better if you just relaxed with your Fungi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't you have a bunch of underlings? Why don't you have them make friends with your Fungi and go on a picnic or an adventure...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Erm, never mind about the adventure part. It's too dangerous for them.

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Hey, you're right! I never got a chance to introduce the members to my Fungi!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Two of them even had the nerve to disguise themselves as competitors and try to steal the "most obedient Fungi foretold in the legends" or something... Good thing they didn't get in trouble for it!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: They could've just played with my Fungi!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why does that sound familiar...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, see? Isn't this better? There's no need to feel bad about it!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: But... I'm their boss... I'm the only one that qualified for the competition... I'm their only hope!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: In the past, we've always had to avoid the Fungi. We didn't dare get too close to them, even though some of them were really cute. Everyone was hoping that I would be able to tame a few as our gang mascots...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: But I failed... It's all over now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then you should really hurry up, shouldn't you? You should let your members spend as much time as they can with your Fungi, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even though only the quarter-finalists are allowed to keep their Fungi after the competition, the competition isn't over yet. You still get to keep your orb and companions for a little longer!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Learn what you can from your loss and fulfill your promise in the next season!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Wait, you're right!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I never expected this White Flying Mushroom could be so smart! Thank...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're welcome.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're very welcome!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Erm... it still doesn't feel right to say it!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: You two! I'll let you off the hook this time! You just make sure you win the whole competition!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: That way, when I defeat you guys next time, I'll become the most popular competitor!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't tell if she's trying to be funny or irritating...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh alright, you have a deal! Make sure you get stronger before we meet again in the arena!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: *sigh* ...I suppose feeling down isn't gonna solve anything. I need to pick myself up and get back to my members... I'll see you guys around!
